source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.

source: A dot makes a note half again as long. In bar two, F sharp rings for a beat and a half, G slips in on the and of two, and A lands on three.

source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
